rows.notes: [SC200] COBCO (Al Mada / CNGR JV, Jorf Lasfar) launched phase-1 NCM pCAM production on 25 June 2025 (S1, Batteries International 2025-06-30). S1 states only an 'eventual annual 70 GWh' scale and gives no phase-1 tonnage; the existing capacity (120,000 t pCAM) is left unchanged and not re-confirmed here. Search results also say full plan is 120,000 t NMC pCAM plus 60,000 t LFP cathode, LFP 'as soon as a regional LFP ecosystem emerges' (no development decision, so the LFP line is NOT added as a pipeline row). A later report (SCMP, late January, year not shown in snippet) says production started in late January, probably 2026; not confirmed.

[SC200] Tangier Tech City integrated synthetic-graphite anode plant of BTR Mediterranean Anode New Material Technology; 60,000 t/yr per AIIB project document and several press items (reported tier: AIIB PDF text not readable, figure taken from search summary). AIIB loan about USD 65m of ~USD 363m project cost. No source found confirming that construction has finished or production started; electrive (2024) estimated 2026 or 2027. A '120,000 t' figure in the task brief is not supported by any source found (existing row's 2026 ref year kept). Status under_construction retained from earlier row; physical works not independently re-confirmed in SC200. [lead] capacity_ref_year = access-year (source undated) fallback.

[SC200] Investment agreement June 2025 (Tinci Materials Jorf Lasfar SAS, Jorf Lasfar industrial park, El Jadida province): integrated base with 150,000 t/yr of 'electrolyte products and critical raw materials' (mixed scope, entered as t electrolyte; raw-material split not stated). Investment 2.576 bn MAD (2025) / 2.8 bn MAD (Telquel 2026-02-10). La Vie Eco headline says Tinci 'launches construction'; no source with site-works detail was opened, so under D-020 the status is set to announced (was under_construction). capacity_ref_year 2026 is the publication-year fallback (no due year stated; OFweek mentions Q3 2026 production but that article also describes cathode/anode scope and is not trusted). Downgrade should be reversed if works are evidenced.

[SC200] Ultium CAM (POSCO Future M 85% / GM 15%), Becancour: phase 1 20,000 t/yr high-nickel CAM, start-up schedule reported as late October 2026 (Korea Herald; GM page still says 2026). Phase 2 (reported planned totals 33,000 t CAM and 45,000 t pCAM) is paused and Vale cancelled the nickel sulfate plant for it (Global News) - no phase-2 row added (no date, total-vs-increment unclear, D-015). Source pages returned 403 / were not opened: reported tier. Hand-back flag: GM's own page's 30,000 t figure refers to the full build-out.

[SC200] Umicore press release 2024-11-06 (S2): 'Umicore has decided to continue to pause construction of its battery materials plant in Loyalist, Ontario, Canada.' Paused, not cancelled; the AESC supply deal is to be served from Korea. No later restart found. Capacity left null (not re-confirmed).
